caption: This drawing shows two views of the same cylindrical object, likely a crown or a ceremonial band, set vertically in the center of a light beige background. The upper view is an underside perspective, depicting an oval bottom where a fish and a bird design are visible; the bird is on the left with detailed features in a muted, light brown color, and the fish is on the right with greenish scales and an outlined profile. The exterior surface of the object has repetitive, vertical, leaf-like patterns colored in shades of brown, green, and dark gray. The lower view is a side perspective, showing the band as a complete vertical cylinder with repeating vertical textures along the perimeter. Both views display a circular white hole toward the lower edge of the band, opposite one another, and the band itself has a weathered appearance with visible shading and highlights to simulate depth and curvature.
title: Cake Mold
